title: Instagram Username Extractor — Keyword Scraper (Phase 1b)
description: Discovers Instagram usernames via keyword search. Treats seed keywords as seeds, auto-discovers related hashtags to expand scope, then optionally paginates hashtag feeds for deeper coverage. Saves state so it survives server migrations.

keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: Starting search terms. Actor auto-discovers related hashtags and searches them too. Use natural phrases (e.g. 'running coach', 'marathon runner') — not hashtag format.

maxKeywords.title: Max total keywords to search (Phase A)
maxKeywords.description: Total keywords to search across both seed keywords and auto-discovered hashtag names. Each keyword search returns ~10–30 usernames.

expandViaHashtags.title: Expand via hashtag feeds (Phase B)
expandViaHashtags.description: After keyword search, also paginate the hashtag feeds discovered during search. This significantly increases username coverage (same as the hashtag scraper).

maxHashtags.title: Max hashtag feeds to paginate (Phase B)
maxHashtags.description: Only applies when 'Expand via hashtag feeds' is enabled. Each hashtag feed gives ~200–1200 usernames depending on pages.

maxPagesPerHashtag.title: Pages per hashtag (Phase B)
maxPagesPerHashtag.description: Each page = ~12–24 usernames. Default 10 pages ≈ 120–240 usernames per hashtag.

sessionId.title: Instagram Session ID
sessionId.description:
Your Instagram sessionid cookie. Required — without it Instagram blocks all requests.

How to get it:
1. Log in to Instagram in Chrome
2. Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com
3. Copy the value of the 'sessionid' cookie

Or run in the Chrome console:
document.cookie.split(';').find(c=>c.trim().startsWith('sessionid')).split('=')[1]

csrfToken.title: Instagram CSRF Token
csrfToken.description:
Your Instagram csrftoken cookie. Strongly recommended alongside sessionId.

Chrome console:
document.cookie.split(';').find(c=>c.trim().startsWith('csrftoken')).split('=')[1]

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended for Instagram. Without them expect heavy 429 / 401 rate limiting.
